independent_structural_check.runtime: Ruby 2.6.10 with system Psych YAML parser
argv:
require "yaml"
ARGV.each do |path|
 text = File.read(path)
 match = text.match(/\A---\n(.*?)\n---/m)
 raise "Invalid frontmatter: #{path}" unless match
 meta = YAML.safe_load(match[1])
 raise "Not a mapping" unless meta.is_a?(Hash)
 raise "Unknown fields" unless (meta.keys - %w[name description license allowed-tools metadata]).empty?
 name = meta['name']; desc = meta['description']
 raise "Invalid name" unless name.is_a?(String) && name.match?(/\A[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*\z/) && name.length <= 64
 raise "Invalid description" unless desc.is_a?(String) && !desc.empty? && desc.length <= 1024 && !desc.match?(/[<>]/) && !desc.start_with?('[TODO:')
 raise "Unfinished placeholder" if text.match?(/^\s*\[TODO:[^\n]*\]\s*$/)
 puts "PASS #{path}: parsed YAML, supported keys, name/description constraints, no scaffold placeholder"
end
